sentences.text:
Mr. Justice D.Dash
 Mr. Justice G. Satapathy
 Order
Order No. 13.11.2023
 01. 1.
This matter is taken up through hybrid arrangement  (virtual/physical) mode.
2. Miss Babita Sahu, learned Central Govt. Counsel, by filing Memo of Appearance, enters appearance on behalf of the Opposite Party Nos.3 and 4 in Court today, which is taken on record.

3. The Petitioners by filing this writ Petition have invoked the jurisdiction of this Court under Ariticle-226 & 227 of the Constitution of India in advancing the prayer as under:-
"Issue writ / writs in the nature of certiorari/ mandamus or any other writ/directions directing the Deputy Chief Engineer (Construction) South Eastern Railway,
Jharsuguda to consider the grievance of the Petitioners and take decision on the same regarding fixation of Uniform and fair price for all the acquired lands for construction of Double Line Fly over Railway project, Jharsuguda Town."
4.
Heard Mr. P.K. Satapathy, learned Counsel for the Petitioners and Mr. G.N. Rout, learned Additional Standing Counsel as well as Miss B. Sahu, learned Central Govt. Counsel.

// 2 //
5. The claim of the Petitioners as would be seen from their representation under Annexure-6 for fixation of market price of the land belonging to them which have been acquired, at a rate higher than the bench mark valuation and also to take some other factors into consideration for fixing the market price.

The move at this stage is premature as the Petitioners have all the right for seeking reference as provided under the RFCTLAR & R Act, 2013 in the event, they are not satisfied with the assessment Jaydhar Pradhan & Others vs State Of Odisha & Others ....
